title: S4, governance
summary: Simulated. Nine days on, the township general manager opens the governance board: passes expiring within 30 days, overdue work and unknown coverage. The agent drafts the monthly report from the records; drafting calls Claude, so it plays against the API only.

events.note: 09:00 local, 31 Oct: the general manager opens the board on the passes that expire within 30 days.
And the open work orders, with what is overdue.
The general manager asks the agent for October's governance report. The agent drafts it, citing the record IDs it used; it cannot send or approve anything.
